about: Sonic Advance (USA)'s save memory, a 64 KB flash in sixteen sectors of 4,096 bytes: what of it isn't the game's save, and so isn't compared with a Dreamport's (docs/STANDARD.md#saves)
leftover: Sector 0 of the game's ten. Its write (0x08012D4C) hands the flash its 0x430-byte save in the console's memory and the flash takes the whole sector, so what the memory held after the save goes in too. Its read (0x08012C5C) and its check before a write read back 0x430 bytes of a sector and no more.
